For The Offences Punishable U/Sec. 498A,
504, 143, 147, 148, 149, 323, 324, 506 Of Ipc And 4 Of D.P Act
Which Is Pending Before The Hon'Ble Prl. Civil Judge And

Jmfc At Sirguppa, Against The Petitioners/A2, A3, A5 To A9
And A11.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 -3-
 Nc: 2024:Khc-D:3359
 Crl.P No. 100961 of 2023
 Order
1.
This petition is filed challenging the registration of a criminal case against the petitioners which has been subsequently investigated and a charge sheet has also been laid.

2. The petitioners are accused Nos.2 to 11.
3.
A reading of the complaint and also the charge sheet would indicate that the allegations against the petitioners/accused herein are general in nature.

4. The statement of the wife also indicates that only the husband and her the mother-in-law had assaulted the brother and the father of the wife.
5. In my view, since there is no overt act attributed against the other accused, the proceedings against them on the basis of general statement that all of them assaulted the complainant, wife and family cannot be accepted.
Consequently the proceedings as against the petitioner Nos.1, 3 to 8, who are accused Nos.2 and 5 to NC: 2024:KHC-D:3359 11 are quashed.
The proceedings against the accused Nos.1 and 3 i.e the husband and mother-in-law shall continue.

Sd/-
